specification.title: Working Draft, Standard for Programming Language C++ (N4659)
specification.version: C++17 working draft N4659 (2017-03-21); accepted DRs named by tests separately

inventory.notes: Incomplete source-oriented C++17 feature inventory, not an official run-pass suite denominator. Supported rows describe bounded capabilities and retain their actually executed historical compiler revisions; matching source bytes do not qualify execution on a later integrated master. Only the constructor scalar-direct evidence triplet and passed entry were renewed from retained bdb execution to replace a stale unit-file binding; all other published evidence remains historical. New DMI/placement/cstddef/decltype/nullptr/SysV-varargs/postfix scopes do not establish native pcc1, full bootstrap, five-GC, NumPy or complete C++17 acceptance. Known external-reference failures and missing native prerequisites remain explicit below. Current unchanged TinyXML2 frontier is the in-class StrPair constructor and external-inline ODR; no owned project executable exists.

features.title: Non-inline non-static member functions through pointer receivers
features.scope: Bounded non-inherited/non-virtual classes: out-of-class definitions, arrow and implicit-this calls, const/non-const overloads, private access, object-before-argument evaluation and typed ABI. Twenty-three exact caller/method programs execute against independently supplied foreign object storage; a separate C++ reference provider supplies storage only. This does not qualify constructors, dot-receiver addresses, inline ODR, native pcc1, standalone projects or a private runtime. Same-source explicit G++ reference is not a production dependency. Independent ABI, two-TU and export tests are additionally recorded in the historical cb41 qualification, not counted as 26 independent executions. The 23 unchanged original inputs, fixtures and unit/runtime test functions were requalified on e816; all 46 exact node calls passed and all retained owned/reference executions were independently rechecked. Original cb41 records remain in published Git history, not relabeled as recovered artifacts.

features.title: Class-template complete-object D1 ownership, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for primary destructor MethodPatterns, concrete D1 declarations, access-checked automatic destruction-use requests, FIFO external-ODR emission and the shared normal-exit cleanup/proof owner. Dependent delete retains typed syntax and fails at actual use without owned deallocation. Explicit D1 without a bound proof, nested unbound template cleanup, local class/reference/array replay, allocating new/delete and original DynArray/TinyXML2 acceptance remain unqualified.

features.title: Class-template self-reference copy declarations, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for declaration-only self lvalue-reference copy constructors and assignment members, injected-to-concrete referent identity, const and access preservation, per-specialization C1/assignment mangling and address ABI. No implicit copy overload or body is fabricated. Selected private constructors fail access before scheduling; public unavailable copy bodies fail explicitly. Copy definitions, assignment calls, generic reference-parameter Patterns and class-reference results remain boundaries. Also retains the exact CI-failed ordinary reference-returning operator[] and zero-argument dependent explicit-template-call programs through their existing semantic owners. Exact TinyXML2 private declaration excerpts do not establish original DynArray or project acceptance.

features.title: Dependent member array-new Patterns, awaiting validation
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for one-dimensional uninitialized array-new Patterns in class-template member bodies when allocated type or bound is dependent. Allocated type identity, integral first-bound expressions, definition-point local bindings and global lookup syntax are retained without token replay. First bounds may be runtime values or zero; known constant negative lengths are rejected independently of fixed-array bound rules. Concrete void/reference/incomplete/const-scalar restrictions and class-element lifetime gates are checked before any allocation lowering. Every odr-used new[] still fails before IR at the owned allocation/lookup/size/failure/initialization/deallocation boundary; no default allocator or successful allocation value is fabricated. Native positive observers execute only unrelated supported members or separate entry units, not allocation. Both formerly rejected unused-body original inputs are preserved unchanged. Function-template, scalar, nondependent, initialized, multidimensional, converted nonintegral and unevaluated new forms retain explicit gaps. Native pcc1 frontend, allocation runtime and unchanged TinyXML2 acceptance remain unqualified. No local tests, imports, compilers or collection were run.

features.title: Class-template body-local pointer/cv declarations, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for body-local object pointers and cv scalar/pointer declarations in class-template members, including definition-point symbol identity, dependent local const initialization checks, ordinary typed Pattern substitution/storage, pointer and pointee qualifiers, local shadowing, injected-class pointer identity, once-only subscript addresses, static members, full-width scalar storage, lazy unused bodies and cross-TU external-ODR identity. Function-template pointer/cv typing, volatile access, local class/array/reference lifetime, callbacks and allocation remain explicit boundaries. Exact TinyXML2 header local-declaration excerpts are preserved but do not establish unchanged PushArr, EnsureCapacity or project acceptance. No local tests, PCC imports, compiler runs or collection were performed; CI must establish every authored outcome. Native pcc1 frontend and complete C++17 remain unqualified.

features.title: First-declaration defaulted destructors, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for non-template first-declaration defaulted D1s, independent deletion/triviality/user-provided identity, recursive implicit-member deletion and access checks, and lazy emitted bodies through the existing exact member-cleanup proof and external-ODR worklist. Class completion classifies deletion before deferred default arguments and DMIs, including the unchanged deleted-D1 unevaluated default-argument counterexample. Unused declarations and valid unevaluated calls request no member body. Ordinary, placement, reverse-order, return, loop, nested-member, body-local and cross-TU original programs have authored owned-native/reference rows; no observed pass is claimed. The exact formerly rejected defaulted declaration is preserved unchanged as a positive original. Implicit nontrivial D1 synthesis, template/later defaulting, explicit exception specifications, class-array lifetimes, unknown destructor effects, unavailable evaluated-use bodies, bases/virtual dispatch, internal-linkage ownership and unwinding remain explicit boundaries. Native pcc1 frontend and unchanged TinyXML2 project acceptance remain unqualified. No local tests, imports, compilers or collection were run; CI must establish these outcomes.

acceptance.scope: Complete bounded first-declaration defaulted-D1 corpus, including all parametrized unit, owned-native, reference and rejection obligations
acceptance.reason: Source-only implementation and authored obligations; user delegated execution to CI. No unit, native program, external reference, collection or validator execution was performed. The revision identifies the immutable corrected source/test patch, not an executed compiler. Native pcc1 and unchanged TinyXML2 project acceptance remain unqualified.

features.title: Scalar/pointer array member semantics, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun source/owned-native/reference obligations for complete scalar/pointer array data members, natural target record layout and sticky size-overflow failures, nested explicit aggregate initialization and omitted/empty zero initialization, const-element deletion/mutability, defaulted-C1 zero prefixes, omitted constructor no-store plans, bounded explicit-empty constructor zero loops, trivial destruction, class-template array decay/subscripts, placement and explicit D1 reuse. No uninitialized scalar is read in the native corpus. Exact formerly rejected originals and TinyXML2 constructor/field excerpts are retained unchanged. Class-element arrays, array DMIs, braced constructor-array initialization, brace elision, function-template arrays, copy/move synthesis, heap allocation runtime, native pcc1 frontend and unchanged TinyXML2 project acceptance remain unqualified boundaries. No local tests, PCC imports, compilers or collection were run; CI must establish the authored outcomes.

features.title: Typed class-template constant array bounds, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for definition-point typed fixed and value-dependent class-template array bounds, integral non-type parameter identities, nested pointer-to-array substitution, target constant proofs, lazy completeness and sticky diagnostics. Pointer-to-array member layout, row stride, cv and cross-TU nominal ABI reuse the existing C aggregate and pointer owners. The exact previously rejected fixed-array primary declaration is retained unchanged as a positive declaration-only input. Class-element array data-member lifetime, function-template array decay, function-template array deduction/signatures, class-array lifetime, native pcc1 frontend and unchanged TinyXML2 project acceptance remain explicit unqualified boundaries. The TinyXML2 header field excerpt is not an executed DynArray or project result. No local tests, PCC imports, compiler runs or collection were performed; CI must establish these outcomes.

features.title: Reference results and class-template subscript members, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for direct scalar/object-pointer lvalue-reference return identity and pointer ABI, const-preserving call lvalues, C++17 non-static one-parameter operator[] declarations and member dispatch, and typed dependent builtin-subscript Patterns replayed through the existing once-only address owner. Temporary/class/array/function reference results, reference locals/data members, reference-parameter Patterns, class-element dependent array members and allocating new/delete remain explicit boundaries. Exact TinyXML2 member excerpts are not original DynArray or whole-project acceptance.

features.title: Shared natural-record and dependent sizeof queries, awaiting execution
features.scope: Authored, execution-unrun obligations for class storage queries using the same extracted natural-record calculation as C IR storage, target-owned scalar/alignment facts, one-byte empty-class projection, and typed dependent sizeof replay with no runtime operand or member-body use. The original defaulted-C1 interior/tail-padding program remains unchanged. This shared C layout-owner change requires wider C/C++ ABI/layout review and complete affected-language CI before publication; focused assertions do not qualify it. Bases, virtual state, bit-fields, class-element arrays, general allocation/deallocation and unchanged TinyXML2 acceptance remain unqualified.

features.title: Non-inline complete-object constructors
features.scope: Non-inline complete-object C1, automatic direct/default construction, scalar/pointer fields with declaration-order initialization. Not copy/list/base/nontrivial subobjects/inline or unwind. Only host pcc0/self linux-x86_64 qualification; GC not applicable. Evidence below binds one representative original; tests list retains all actually passing nodes in these scoped test files, not independent feature-completeness claims. Native pcc1, full bootstrap, five-GC, unmodified TinyXML2, NumPy and full C++17 are not qualified.

features.title: Non-inline automatic complete-object destruction on normal exits
features.scope: Non-inline complete-object D1 on normal structured automatic exits, reverse construction order and return-value capture before cleanup. Not delete/base/subobjects/arrays/EH/inline ODR. Only host pcc0/self linux-x86_64 qualification; GC not applicable. Evidence below binds one representative original; tests list retains all actually passing nodes in these scoped test files, not independent feature-completeness claims. Native pcc1, full bootstrap, five-GC, unmodified TinyXML2, NumPy and full C++17 are not qualified.

features.title: Owned cstddef target declarations
features.scope: Owned size_t/ptrdiff_t target aliases, distinct nullptr_t and repeated header acquisition. max_align_t is deliberately incomplete; offsetof and byte operations remain unavailable. Linux x86_64 runtime only; other target assertions are syntax/type checks, not native ABI qualification. Host pcc0/self only; no native pcc1, bootstrap, five-GC, TinyXML2 whole-project, NumPy or full C++17 acceptance.

features.title: Nondependent decltype entity/prvalue typing
features.scope: Entity type and supported prvalue deduction, completed-class member lookup and unevaluated operand effects; scalar functional-prvalue top-level cv removal. References, functions, decltype(auto), dependent templates remain explicit gaps. Host pcc0/self only; no native pcc1, bootstrap, five-GC, TinyXML2 whole-project, NumPy or full C++17 acceptance.

features.title: Distinct nullptr_t and no-fetch lvalue conversion
features.scope: Dn semantic/ABI identity with void-pointer storage, no-fetch lvalue-to-rvalue conversion preserving once-only base/address effects, copy/parameter/result and null-pointer conversion. This is not a void* semantic alias. Four logical-not originals still have external G++ rejection differences; owned-only successful executions do not make those differential passes. Host pcc0/self only; no native pcc1, bootstrap, five-GC, TinyXML2 whole-project, NumPy or full C++17 acceptance.

features.title: Scalar/pointer default member initialization
features.scope: Completed-class typed binding, constructor override and declaration-order once-only execution. No textual name substitution; no braced DMI/aggregate-list/copy/subobject/global/array or exception-unwind support. Host pcc0/self Linux x86_64 only; not native pcc1/full C++17/TinyXML2/NumPy/five-GC acceptance.

features.title: Reserved nonallocating placement and complete-object lifetime
features.scope: Exact standard nonallocating placement signature, once-only storage evaluation, C1 initialization, explicit D1/trivial destruction and transparent replacement. No allocating new/delete, general allocation overloads, throwing constructor cleanup, full new header or inline ODR support. Host pcc0/self Linux x86_64 only; not native pcc1/full C++17/TinyXML2/NumPy/five-GC acceptance.

features.title: Owned SysV variadic definitions and cursor operations
features.scope: Free-function variadic declarations/definitions and default promotions; real SysV record-array va_list, scalar va_arg, va_start/copy/end and effectful cursor operands. Reuses C intrinsic finalization; no external helper stubs. Member variadics, other va_list targets, callback and nontrivial record-array lifetimes remain explicit gaps. Host pcc0/self Linux x86_64 only; not native pcc1/full C++17/TinyXML2/NumPy/five-GC acceptance.

features.title: Typed postfix old-value and row-stride projection
features.scope: Builtin postfix increment/decrement captures the typed operand address once before update and returns the old value. Includes the unchanged confirmed pointer-to-array formal miscompile, row-width/const/nested cases and scalar behavior; not user-defined operator overloading. Host pcc0/self Linux x86_64 only; not native pcc1/full C++17/TinyXML2/NumPy/five-GC acceptance.
